should_trigger.prompt: build me a cold email sequence targeting VP of Engineering at Series B startups
write cold outreach for our new devtools product — need a 4-touch cadence
my cold email reply rate is 0.8%, help me optimize the sequence
create an outbound cadence for prospecting mid-market SaaS companies
I need a prospecting sequence for HR directors at companies with 200–500 employees
sequence for selling DevOps tooling to platform leads at fintechs — four touches
my open rate collapsed after touch two; rebuild the cadence
I need to reach VPs of Engineering at Series B companies and I get one shot at the subject line
should_trigger.note: situation phrasing: describes the circumstance without reusing the description's routing vocabulary — tests under-triggering, the axis lexical overlap hides

should_not_trigger.prompt: write an email to our existing customers announcing the new feature
draft a newsletter for our subscriber list
should_not_trigger.note: newsletter to opt-in list, not cold outreach

should_not_trigger.prompt: write a follow-up email to someone I met at a conference who gave me their card
create an event invitation email for our webinar
write the welcome email for new signups
panel-review this cold email before it goes to 500 prospects
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: content-scorer's own trigger phrasing — same artifact (a cold email), but the ask is to score a finished draft, not to build or rewrite the cadence; outbound-builder must not claim it
